correctness.rationale: From the literal 2024 matrix update, the normalization to a convex combination of the identity-setting Schur complement is exact. Equation (4) gives a nonnegative Stein divergence drop whose equality set is MV=V; compact SPD sublevels and finite-window spanning force the full matrix to the isotropic fixed point. The exact two-direction Jacobian characteristic polynomial has eigenvalues lambda squared and r±; its dominant eigenvalue is achieved by nearby nonlinear trajectories and has the verified quadratic angular asymptotic. Ordinary exponentially forgotten Gram eigenvalues give the stated condition-number asymptotic. The reproducible numerical verifier passed 2565 checks, including direct matrix replay and finite differences.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies the complete limiting covariance for nonperiodic uniformly spanning equal-strength vector batches, more informative than existing universal SPD bounds. It shows a sharp inverse-square angular mixing-time penalty even when SIFt eliminates the inverse-square information condition-number blow-up suffered by ordinary forgetting. This is a motivated distinction between limiting conditioning and adaptation speed, with exact source algorithm and clear scope.
